import datetime


def streak(days):
    dates = sorted(datetime.date.fromisoformat(day) for day in days)
    count = 1 if dates else 0
    for before, after in zip(dates, dates[1:]):
        count = count + 1 if (after - before).days == 1 else 1
    return count

import unittest

from app.chart import month_chart


class ChartTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_one_value_per_day(self):
        chart = month_chart(2026, 2, ["2026-02-03", "2026-02-03", "2026-02-10"])
        self.assertEqual(len(chart), 28)
        self.assertEqual(chart[2], 2)
        self.assertEqual(chart[9], 1)

import datetime

from app.chart_days import days_in


def month_chart(year, month, ticks):
    days = [datetime.date.fromisoformat(tick) for tick in ticks]
    return [sum(1 for day in days if (day.year, day.month, day.day) == (year, month, number)) for number in range(1, days_in(year, month) + 1)]
